goal: Allow external mining coordinators to validate custom block templates without keeping a mirror mempool
Reduce memory and IPC bandwidth by fetching only missing transactions via a new TxCollection interface
agreement: Strong support with substantive concept approvals and all past technical concerns resolved
Supports avoiding duplicate mempool storage and mirror synchronization outside the node (enirox001)
Concept approved after running the test suite and inspecting the coinbase refactoring (jeanpablojp)
Concept approval without stated reasons (ismaelsadeeq, pablomartin4btc)
